subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Cities are full of people solving their daily problems by walking.”?
options: Technology can support good habits, but it should not become an excuse to stop looking, smelling, planning, and thinking.
Sometimes it is quiet work that makes other good things possible.
Good planning begins by noticing those movements before someone gets hurt.
But it taught students that city planning is often about balancing needs, not choosing between good and bad.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Technology can support good habits, but it should not become an excuse to stop looking, smelling, planning, and…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it is quiet work that makes other good things possible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Cities are full of people solving their daily problems by walking. Good planning begins by noticing those movements before someone gets hurt.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「But it taught students that city planning is often about balancing needs, not choosing between good and bad.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Cities are full of people solving their daily problems by walking. Good planning begins by noticing those movements before someone gets hurt.」，答案為「Good planning begins by noticing those movements before someone gets hurt.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Good planning begins by noticing those movements before someone gets hurt.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
